text: I never had sensor fall off, i wash back part of arm with bar soap (one that you will newer use for shower because it dries your skin) dry it with paper towel and let it dry completely for another 5-10 minutes, then I clean it with medical benzine (much better and faster evaporates than alcohol) and after few minutes I apply sensor.
